title: MCP tools return model-facing views, not engine records
body:
Keep engine bookkeeping out of MCP output. retrieve returns only {abstained, memories[id, memory_type, content, lifecycle_state?, contested?, contradicts?], pointers?} where each pointer is its one rendered line; get returns the atom without retrieval_forms, what, evidence_state, project_id, registry_key_id, schema_version, activation_count, with each evidence_ref annotated by its verification status only. The raw atom is behind get verbose=true. Add new engine fields to HIT_FIELDS/ENGINE_FIELDS in src/mcp/tools.js deliberately, not by default.

Why: Measured 2026-09-22: about 4.2 KB of the 7 KB get payload was duplicated authored text plus evidence hashes; the compact view cut get by 60.9% with no authored content removed. Pointers joined the retrieve view with pull-first delivery, as rendered lines rather than records. Budget accounting stays in the engine, so the stripped view is always within the budget the engine enforced.

evidence.summary: retrieveView returns abstained, memories with HIT_FIELDS and pointers as lines; atomView drops ENGINE_FIELDS; get accepts verbose.
Asserts the retrieve keys, compact get fields, evidence status and the verbose raw atom.

issues: archived_by_person: describes the MCP tool views

v1.trigger: When adding fields to retrieve results or atoms, or changing what MCP retrieve/get return
